name: gap_fill_full_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gaps of 0.3–1.0% create a marked divergence from the prior session's institutional benchmark levels. VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (mutual funds, FIIs executing large directional mandates) begin accumulating against the gap direction from the first bar, as they receive better-than-VWAP fills when NIFTY is below (gap down) or above (gap up) the intraday VWAP. The first cross of intraday VWAP — typically 15–45 minutes after open — signals that accumulated institutional pressure has overwhelmed retail gap-chasing flow, creating a directional impulse of 15–25 NIFTY spot points over the next 30–90 seconds as momentum followers pile in behind the institutional accumulation. At 5-second resolution we enter exactly at the VWAP cross bar, capturing this first impulse rather than waiting for a full 1-minute bar confirmation.

indicators.name: gap_pct
indicators.purpose: Day-level gap magnitude. No lookback — computed from first bar's open vs previous session's last close. Filter: 0.3–1.0% gap in either direction. Gaps <0.3% are noise; gaps >1.0% are likely structural news events where institutional fill incentive is overridden by fundamental repricing.

indicators.name: vwap_intraday
indicators.formula: cumsum(close * volume) / cumsum(volume), reset each day from 09:15
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session start. No lookback scaling needed — cumulative measure. Used to detect the first cross which marks inflection of institutional vs retail flow direction.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: 3-minute RSI at 5s bars. Original used 14-min RSI at 1-min bars. Compressed to 3 min (36 bars) because we are entering at the VWAP cross and need a fast signal confirming the cross is not coming from extreme territory (RSI>60 for gap up bearish cross, or RSI<40 for gap down bullish cross would be worrying signs of continued trend). 3 min is responsive enough to the actual entry bar without looking back so far it loses intraday relevance.

indicators.name: vwap_cross_bullish
indicators.purpose: Detects the exact 5s bar where NIFTY close crosses above intraday VWAP. This is the entry trigger for gap-down gap-fill trades (buy CE). Using 1-bar crossover rather than level comparison to avoid re-entering mid-trend.

indicators.name: vwap_cross_bearish
indicators.purpose: Detects the exact 5s bar where NIFTY close crosses below intraday VWAP. Entry trigger for gap-up gap-fill trades (buy PE).

conditions: gap_pct between -1.0% and -0.3% (gap down day: NIFTY opened below prev close)
vwap_cross_bullish == True (first time NIFTY close crosses above intraday VWAP)
rsi_36 < 60 (not overbought — cross is not from extreme RSI territory)
time_minutes in [560, 630] (09:20–10:30 IST: gap fill window, avoid late crosses)
vix_close < 20 (high VIX gaps are more likely structural news repricing, not sentiment)
buy_ce.confirmation: Close crosses above VWAP on the current 5-second bar (previous bar was below VWAP)

conditions: gap_pct between 0.3% and 1.0% (gap up day: NIFTY opened above prev close)
vwap_cross_bearish == True (first time NIFTY close crosses below intraday VWAP)
rsi_36 > 40 (not oversold — cross is not from extreme RSI territory)
buy_pe.confirmation: Close crosses below VWAP on the current 5-second bar (previous bar was above VWAP)

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts (~8 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). If the VWAP cross is a genuine gap fill inflection, NIFTY should not fall back more than 8 spot points below the cross level within 2 minutes — deeper retracement signals the institutional accumulation thesis has failed and gap may extend.
exit.target_rationale: 7 option pts (~14 NIFTY spot pts at delta 0.5). The first post-VWAP-cross impulse on a gap fill day covers 15–20 spot points over 30–90 seconds as momentum algos join the institutional flow. 14 pts captures the first leg conservatively (R:R 1:1.75). Full gap fill (0.5% = ~110 pts) takes hours; we only target the first impulse.

filters.vix_filter: India VIX < 20; VIX >= 20 implies macro-driven gap likely to extend rather than fill
filters.time_filter: 09:20–10:30 IST only; gap fill momentum crosses outside this window are too late in the session to be reliable
filters.volume_filter: none — index volume is noisy; VWAP cross captures volume implicitly
filters.trend_filter: none — strategy is inherently counter-trend (fading the gap direction)
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close, no spread cost

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — institutional VWAP benchmarking is structural and has persisted for decades; gap fill rates on NIFTY are well-documented at 60-70% for moderate gaps

adaptation_notes: Original traded individual NIFTY50 constituent stocks; this version trades the NIFTY index directly. Key changes: (1) gap_pct computed on NIFTY index open vs prev session close, eliminating cross-sectional stock screening; (2) VWAP cross still used as confirmation entry but now on index VWAP, not stock VWAP; (3) RSI period compressed from 14 (14-min at 1-min bars) to 36 (3-min at 5s bars) to remain responsive at 5s frequency; (4) hold time compressed from 30-180 min to 30-120 sec — we capture the first VWAP-cross impulse only, not the full gap fill journey; (5) stops/targets in option premium points calibrated to 30-90s NIFTY move magnitudes rather than ATR-based. Equity-specific filters (earnings, corporate actions, stock-specific news) removed as irrelevant for index.
weaknesses: NIFTY gap fill rate depends on whether the gap is sentiment-driven or structural; no reliable filter to distinguish these at entry time other than VIX
On 'trending gap' days where NIFTY gaps and continues in the gap direction all day, this strategy can lose repeatedly — the VIX<20 filter partially addresses this but doesn't eliminate it
VWAP cross signal can fire multiple times intraday; the time filter (09:20-10:30) attempts to isolate only the first meaningful cross but may still catch false crosses on volatile open

_source.original_stop: gap extends by 50% from open OR 0.5 * ATR_14
